idea: Cold open: an export dialog 'Choose export quality for yourself'. MP3 128 kbps is pre-selected as 'recommended', FLAC is tagged 'too big', a checkbox says 'you won't notice the difference'. A cursor glides over and clicks EXPORT; an encoding bar starts.
Dark screen, a white waveform across the frame; a red 'psychoacoustic model' blade slides in and shaves every peak off. The lyric is huge type above it, 'notice' in a highlight block.

A Recycle Bin window, 'deleted by: codec': harmonics_16k-22k.raw (inaudible*), room_tone.wav, breath_03.aif, string_decay.flac (too long), the_tremble.tmp, and in red 'you (partial).bin, you won't notice'. Fine print: '* according to a model of your ears'.
Title card: LOSSLESS in giant condensed type, 'LESS' lands in a highlight block on a downbeat. Small mono line: 'a song about not being compressed'.
Extreme close-up of his eye snapping open on 'noticed', speed lines radiating, a tiny waveform reflected in the iris.
2 a.m., from behind: he sits at his desk in the dark, one monitor glowing, IEM cables hanging from both ears, a window with the city asleep. A clock reads 2:00 AM (drawn in code).
Green terminal: '$ sudo pacman -Syu', errors in red, then 'ARCH: BROKE' in huge type; a fan icon spinning at 5400 RPM (roaring).
Three small cards: fastboot flashing a custom ROM (progress bar), 'coffee.temp: 14°C, cold. again.', and 'friends online: 1' where the only friend is a blinking text cursor that types 'hey.'
A dark music player: NOW PLAYING lossless.flac, FLAC 24-bit/96 kHz, 'repeat one: ON', 'loop count: 1,337', 'trust: 100%'. The album art is a manga panel of him, eyes closed, IEMs in.

A repost feed of the same picture: @abhinav (original), @repost_bot, @repost_bot_2, @aggregator ('copy of a copy'). Each repost is blockier until the last one crumbles into grey dust, '[image unavailable]'.

A model card: fine-tuning 'oracle-mini' (RAG), a loss curve falling to LOSS_FN 0.4933 (his site's number), checklist: says 'I don't know' when unsure 100%, hallucinations 0, pretends it's fine: never.
A chat with oracle-mini: 'what's the rated RPM for pump #7?' -> chip 'retrieved 0 / 12 chunks' -> 'I don't know. It isn't in the context.' Fine print: 'no guesses. no vibes.'
He rests his chin on his hand and side-eyes the Oracle, which proudly holds up a blank sign (the words I DON'T KNOW drawn in code). Half-lidded, a little smirk.
Two status cards: oracle-mini, context EMPTY, battery 0%, 'says so. honestly.' vs abhinav, battery 3%, awake 19h, typing 'all good :)' which sends, then 'Read 2:14 AM'.
An export queue: sunset.raw 48 MB -> 212 KB, voice_memo.wav 42 MB -> 3.1 MB, you.human ∞ -> 128 kbps; the bars shrink on the beat.
A digest print layout: SUMMARY (2,400 words) -> SUMMARY OF SUMMARY (240) -> SUMMARY OF SUMMARY OF SUMMARY (24) -> TL;DR 'ok.' cards stacking smaller.
A spectrum analyser; a red LOW-PASS 16 kHz line slides in, the highs fall away; checkbox 'you'll never miss it', stamp TRUST US.
Eyes closed, IEMs glowing, reverb rings spreading through the dark room, a single string ringing and slowly decaying across the bottom of the frame.
Loud flat colour: DON'T COMPRESS ME in giant type squeezed by two vise jaws, then it springs back and the jaws fly out; pill COMPRESSION: ON -> OFF.
A quality dropdown: '320 kbps' and 'smooth (AI enhance)' get struck out on the sung words with a NOT ME stamp; 'lossless' is ticked. Counter: compression attempts 1, passed: none of them.
A wave editor on abhinav.wav with static specks and a trembling line; toggles Noise reduction / De-tremble / Smooth voice (AI) flip OFF on the sung words.
The spectrum again: the shaved 16-22 kHz band (labelled 'truth') grows back; a big KEEP button is pressed on 'truth'.
Ops dashboard: storage 99%, 'server says: make room'. SHRINK is pressed, the WAV file icon shrinks to a dot, then KEEP snaps it back to full size.
A crop tool tightening on his face, 'fit: 1:1, 128x128'; in the manga crop he glares at the handles.
Grinning thumbs-up over the night skyline, sparkles; a LOSSLESS-O-METER card reads 98%, '2% still buffering'.
A file-properties window for abhinav.flac: 24-bit, 96 kHz, 42.1 MB (all of it); BITS LOST: 0, 'every bit: kept'; 0s and 1s drift down behind it.
Instrumental: he and the Oracle both nod to the beat at the desk at night, eyes closed, music notes floating.
Instrumental: a pixel LCD VU meter bouncing to the song, 'NOW PLAYING: lossless.flac'.
'Moving your files: 12,408 / 12,408, all yours' -> a robot arm drops a red padlock on a door -> a red card: ACCOUNT DISABLED, reviewed by: automated system, human review: no.
An app launcher: mail, drive, login, calendar, photos, certificates, coursework, dev tools, backups grey out one by one with red x badges; his avatar becomes 'Unknown user, sign in to continue'.

An appeal form, 'Tell us why we're wrong (max 1000 characters)'; his message types fast ('my degree, my certificates, the voice notes from my mother...'), the counter hits 1000/1000, red bar 'The rest was not sent.'
A risk-engine heatmap; pattern: MASS_TRANSFER MATCH, velocity: HIGH MATCH, intent: 'field not supported' next to a small heart.
Tiny him looking up, sweating, at a giant faceless judge in robes whose head is just a loading spinner; VERDICT: PENDING; 'waiting... day 11' (all text in code).
'Your account has been restored.' Fields Reason / What happened / Apology / Details all show '-'; stamp NO REASON GIVEN; 'no further action is required.'
His work (RAG for pump selection): a query with RPM ? / load ? / service life ? fields; the question marks fall onto soft pink cushions; green card 'Missing info? No dead end. Using typical values.'
A dark gauge cluster: an RPM dial with no needle; a question mark with little legs keeps running across the frame; STILL RUNS.
Split screen: his chat bubbles ('it's on me', 'got the tickets', 'don't worry about it') vs their score.xlsx ledger (trip: he paid, dinner: he paid, chai ₹20: HE OWES, highlighted). LOVE vs SCORE.
2 a.m., top-down: he lies in bed staring at the ceiling, IEMs still in; his phone on the blanket shows 'no new messages'; the Oracle's light is dimmed.
The vise again in a new loud colour; this time the jaws crack apart; stamp BROKEN.
The dropdown again, compression attempts 2, passed: none of them.
The wave editor in its dark variant, toggles flip OFF.
The spectrum fully restored, stamp 100%.
SHRINK is pressed but the KEEP button explodes into confetti; 'request denied: you'.
The crop tool fails: the handles snap back to the full frame, 'fit: none. original.', stamp NOPE.
The thumbs-up again, closer and brighter; meter 99%.
A loud board filling up with 'every bit' reaction stickers on every sung 'bit' (EVERY BIT, KEPT, 0 LOST, 24-BIT, BIT-PERFECT, UNCUT, RAW, ALL OF IT); a giant 1 in the middle; counter 'bits kept'.
Stickers keep piling on until the song's hard stop, where the frame freezes mid-motion.
The hard stop (153.6 s, the beat where the mix cuts out): the sticker board from s47, frozen mid-motion, greys out under a buffering spinner. Near silence until Minus one.
A notebook cell on black: labels = DBSCAN(eps=0.5).fit_predict(life) -> the output prints -1, alone, huge.
Instrumental burst: a whip pan across his face with speed lines, eyes wide, lit up.

A notebook scatter plot of 'life': coloured clusters (work, family, friends) and one grey point labelled '-1 (noise)'; the camera dives into the point and it is a tiny drawing of him. (He really used K-Means and DBSCAN in his Alaska hydrochemistry research.)
A shopping cart: 'Ergonomic chair, in cart for 94 days, times considered: 100' with a grey Buy button vs 'Sent ₹5,000 to a friend, times considered: 0', done instantly.
Hand on his chest, eyes closed, singing out; the sound pours out of his chest as rings; a mute icon cracks.
The Oracle rolls in pushing an office chair with a big bow on it; he looks at it surprised, teary, blushing.
DON'T COMPRESS ME in a third colour; the vise shatters on the downbeat.
A video call: 'Blur background' and 'Smooth skin (AI)' toggles switch off, and he steps out of the blur, sharp.
A vinyl player: 'Remove crackle: OFF', the needle crackles, a trembling waveform.
The spectrum at 100%, KEEP.
Drums out: a self-care checkout. [x] buy the chair [x] get the monitor [x] say it when it hurts; ORDER PLACED; a message 'hey, that hurt a bit.' sends.
Shrink request denied again; the dashboard explodes into confetti.
The crop tool breaks apart.
The biggest thumbs-up, meter 100%, a FLAC 24/96 badge.
Properties: BITS LOST 0, bigger.
He high-fives the Oracle.
Dawn at the desk: first sunlight through the window, eyes closed, smiling, the Oracle asleep beside him.
He looks straight at the camera and smiles: 'really, this time'.
End card: 'Lossless' title, credits 'lyrics: Claude · music: Suno · every frame is JavaScript · abhinavflac.dev', the encoding pill hits 100% 'encoded. 0 bits lost.'
